title: Richard Sherman: Josh Allen needed an IV, was shivering in a hot tub before TNF

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Richard Sherman: Josh Allen needed an IV, was shivering in a hot tub before TNF
sources.description: It certainly didn't look like anything was out of the ordinary for Josh Allen during Thursday night's 41-31 victory over the Lions to open the new Highmark Stadium.
